_comment: gdd-npc-personality.md §4.3 distinctive-feature tables. One memorable detail per NPC, drawn from these pools. Physical / behavioral / possessions are pooled equally for v1.
physical: a long scar across one cheek
a missing finger on the left hand
a wine-stain birthmark on the throat
one blue eye and one brown
an elaborate tattoo coiling up the neck
a sudden shock of white hair
a brand mark on the forearm
a crude prosthetic hand of carved wood
a nose broken and reset crooked
behavioral: fidgets endlessly with a worn coin
writes everything down in a little book
collects buttons and shows them off
refers to themselves in the third person
taps out a rhythm on any nearby surface
possessions: wears a battered, distinctive wide-brimmed hat
is never without a small, scruffy dog
wears two boots that do not match
always has a dog-eared book half-read
is hung with far too much cheap jewelry
touches a lucky charm whenever nervous
keeps a caged songbird close at hand
wears a faded military medal out of place
carries a walking stick topped with carved bone
